history.p: "Foraarstoner" was written at the same time as Gade's prize-winning overture "Nachklänge von Ossian". The dedicatee "Emilie Th..." was probably Emilie Thorsen, who in 1844 married Gade's close friend, the famous Danish actor Michael Wiehe. In 1873 he published a revised edition.

expression.tempo: Andantino (Andantino con moto in the 1873 version)

physDesc.physMedium: 2 bifolios. Written in purple ink. Paper: 14 staves. Paginated 2-7. On p. 8 sketches for another work in blue crayon.

1 bifolio with the insertion of 1 single folio. Written in ink with additions in pencil. Paper: 14 staves. Paginated 1-6. Heading on p. 1: "(Schneeglöckchen.) / Hell und luftig. / Frühlingsblumen / Emilie Th .... dedicirt / an Liane v. Frohlein." In upper right-hand corner added in pencil: "December 1840". On p. 2 title before the first bar: "(Veilchen)." End- dated "Januar 1841". On pp.4-5 no. 3. Title before the first bar: "(Rose)". End-dated Februar 1841".
